Cloudflare's own models, billed to your Gateway's Cloudflare account. No separate sign-up.

**Used by:** [OpenMail](/docs/apps/openmail) can use it as its model provider.

## API key

1. In the Cloudflare dashboard, open the [Workers AI page](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/ai/workers-ai) of your Gateway's account.
2. Select **Use REST API**, then **Create a Workers AI API Token**, then **Create API Token**.
3. Copy the token. It's shown once. The account ID is already set.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add workers-ai
```

To make it the model provider apps get by default:

```bash
everyapp ai default workers-ai
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
providers: ["workers-ai"],
```

The app calls `/api/ai/workers-ai/…` with `createGatewayFetch()`. More in [AI](/docs/agent/ai).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp ai list` shows `workers-ai` with its key set.
